content.title: What time will Daredevil: Born Again season 2 be released on Disney+?
content.text: The Man Without Fear is back in business in Daredevil: Born Again season 2, on a mission to gather allies and save the city from the villainous Kingpin.After the dramatic events of season 1, including a fair few devastating deaths that we're still recovering from, the beloved Marvel series is officially back for another instalment.Fans have got a lot to look forward to but at the top of that list is the long-awaited return of Krysten Ritter's Jessica Jones (although viewers might be waiting a little while to see her in action). Plus, who exactly is Matthew Lillard's mysterious character?Here's everything we know about what time Daredevil: Born Again season 2 will be released on Disney+, so you don't waste a moment!Krysten Ritter plays Jessica Jones in Daredevil: Born Again season 2. Marvel TelevisionThe first episode of Daredevil: Born Again season 2 will be released on Disney+ at 1am GMT on 25 March, meaning a late night for UK fans. When the clocks go forward on 29 March, that will change to 2am GMT.More like thisIn other areas of the world, that works out to the slightly more sociable times of:9pm ET on 24 March (USA)6pm PT on 24 March (USA)7pm CT on 24 March (USA)3am CET on 25 March (Central Europe)10am AWST on 25 March (Australia)12pm AEST on 25 March (Australia)Mark your calendars!Daredevil: Born Again launches on Disney+ UK on Wednesday 25 March 2026.
